cases.translation: Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
cases.explain: The transitive verb наполняйте (fill) takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.translation: Man was created in the image of God.
cases.explain: The preposition по (according to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Ноя, вышедшие из ___, были Сим, Хам и Иофет.
cases.translation: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он опьянел и лежал обнажённый в своём ___.
cases.translation: He got drunk and lay uncovered in his tent.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Ham saw the nakedness of his father.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession ('the nakedness of his father').

cases.translation: Going out, he told his brothers about it.
cases.explain: The verb рассказал (told) takes an indirect object in the dative case (plural).

cases.translation: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Let Canaan be a servant of Shem.
cases.explain: The predicate noun with the verb быть (да будет) takes the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Потому что человек создан по образу Божьему.
reading.question: According to the text, in whose image was man created?
reading.explain: The text says that man was created in the image of God.

reading.ru: Ной принялся возделывать землю и сажать виноград.
reading.question: What did Noah begin to do after the flood?
options: To farm the land and plant a vineyard
reading.correct: To farm the land and plant a vineyard
reading.explain: The text says Noah began to cultivate the ground and plant a vineyard.

reading.ru: Однажды, выпив вина, он опьянел и лежал обнаженный в своем шатре.
reading.question: What happened to Noah after he drank wine?
options: He became drunk and lay uncovered in his tent
He fell asleep in the field
reading.correct: He became drunk and lay uncovered in his tent
reading.explain: The text says that after drinking wine Noah got drunk and lay uncovered in his tent.

reading.ru: Хам, отец Ханаана, увидел наготу своего отца и, выйдя, рассказал об этом братьям.
reading.question: What did Ham do when he saw his father's nakedness?
options: He told his brothers about it
reading.correct: He told his brothers about it
reading.explain: The text says Ham saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers about it.

reading.ru: Всего Ной прожил 950 лет и умер.
reading.question: How many years did Noah live in all?
reading.explain: The text says Noah lived a total of 950 years and then died.

reading.ru: Никогда впредь все живое не будет истреблено водами потопа.
reading.question: What does God promise concerning the flood?
options: All living things will never again be destroyed by floodwaters
The flood will return every year
Only Noah will survive future floods
reading.correct: All living things will never again be destroyed by floodwaters
reading.explain: The text says never again will all living things be destroyed by the waters of a flood.
